spec.title: Power history
spec.description: PV forecast values come from EVCC solar forecast configuration and are stored as tariffSolar_value. If EVCC has no solar forecast provider or no recent tariffSolar_value samples, this forecast remains empty; the dashboard does not fetch Forecast.Solar, Solcast, or Open-Meteo directly.

spec.title: Battery levels
spec.description: Black: prioritization threshold for vehicle charging

spec.expr:
sort_by_label(
  sum without(host) (
    integrate(
      ((chargePower_value{vehicle!="", vehicle !~ "$vehicleBlocklist"}) default 0) [$__range:$energySampleInterval]
    ) / -3600000
  )
, "vehicle")

spec.name: dashboardBuild
spec.label: Build
spec.description: Build information is set during deployment.

spec.name: peakPowerLimit
spec.label: Max power filter / W
spec.description: Maximum power filter in W. Power values above this limit are ignored as outliers.

spec.name: inverterPortalTitle
spec.label: Inverter portal name
spec.description: Name of the inverter portal for the portal link.

spec.name: inverterPortalUrl
spec.label: Inverter portal URL
spec.description: URL used to open the inverter portal.

spec.name: loadpointBlocklist
spec.label: Loadpoint blocklist
spec.description:
List of loadpoints that should NOT be shown. The expression is a regular expression. It must not be empty, so if nothing should be filtered, use a regular expression that matches none of the entries.

Examples:
No entries: ^none$
Filter out 'Garage': ^Garage$
Filter out 'Garage' and 'Parking space': ^Garage$|^Parking space$
Filter out everything starting with 'foo': ^foo.*$

spec.name: vehicleBlocklist
spec.label: Vehicle blocklist
spec.description:
List of vehicles that should NOT be shown. The expression is a regular expression. It must not be empty, so if nothing should be filtered, use a regular expression that matches none of the entries.

Examples:
No entries: ^none$
Filter out 'Garage': ^Garage$
Filter out 'Garage' and 'Parking space': ^Garage$|^Parking space$
Filter out vehicles ending with (offline): ^.*\(offline\)$

spec.name: energySampleInterval
spec.label: Energy sample interval
spec.description: Sampling interval for energy calculations. It should be at least 2x the EVCC polling interval. Default: 60s, because the default EVCC interval is 60s.

spec.name: tariffPriceInterval
spec.label: Tariff price interval
spec.description: Billing interval of the electricity price.
